approaches.title: Selection sort — place the next minimum
approaches.explanation: For every position, find the smallest value in the remaining suffix and swap it into place.

approaches.title: Bubble sort — early-exit adjacent swaps
approaches.explanation: Bubble the largest unsorted value to the end. Stop when an entire pass makes no swap.

approaches.title: Insertion sort — grow a sorted prefix
approaches.explanation: Insert each element into its correct place in the sorted prefix by shifting larger values right.

approaches.title: Single pass — track the running maximum
approaches.explanation: Every element is inspected once; keep only the largest value seen so far.

approaches.title: Single pass — maintain largest and second largest
approaches.explanation: Update the second largest only when a value falls strictly between the two tracked values.

approaches.title: Top-down merge sort — divide and merge
approaches.explanation: Split until each range has one element, then merge two sorted halves with one temporary buffer.

approaches.title: Quick sort — Lomuto partition
approaches.explanation: Partition around a pivot so smaller values move left and larger values move right, then sort both sides.

approaches.title: Two pointers — compact unique values
approaches.explanation: Because the array is sorted, write each new value immediately after the last distinct value.

approaches.title: 3D dynamic programming — synchronize two robots
approaches.explanation: Track both robot columns on each row. Try all nine pairs of next moves and count a cell once when both robots occupy it.

approaches.title: BFS by level + parent map — enumerate shortest paths
approaches.explanation: A level-aware BFS records every predecessor that reaches a word at its shortest distance. Backtracking from the target reconstructs all shortest ladders.
